purpose: 肖像制作の進捗に左右されず、人物中心の全20章プロットを完成・実装する

required: chapter cause and result connect to the full campaign
map objective expresses the chapter conflict
new character has a present-life reason for their position
existing allies receive continuing character beats
boss first-combat dialogue and relevant talk events are designed
village and civilian conversations support world and gameplay
current campaign data carries into the next chapter
fallback speakers prevent story failure after unit withdrawal

forbid: another member's portrait as a substitute
a regenerated group sheet as an identity master
a generic face presented as an approved individual portrait
removing or replacing a character because art is missing
temporaryPresentation.laterPortraitIntegration: Replace only the visual reference. Preserve character id, plot position, class, stats, relationships, dialogue, recruitment logic and save compatibility.

allCharactersMustHave: at least two main-plot decisions outside the join chapter
endgame payoff based on personality and class

implementationOrder: preserve the complete story and character arcs
implement map, dialogue and event logic
use temporary non-face presentation where needed
add each approved individual portrait independently later
spoilerPolicy: Public progress reports, pull-request titles, pull-request bodies and change logs must not disclose hidden identities, allegiances, recruitment conditions, major reveals or ending details.
